description: A corporate bankruptcy risk score where higher values indicate better financial health. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
A measure of sensitivity to the Baltic Dry Index, which tracks global shipping costs for raw materials. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
A measure of a company's total cash and cash equivalents, often ranked or standardized cross-sectionally. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
The rate at which a company uses its cash reserves to finance overhead before generating positive cash flow from operations. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
A leverage ratio measuring total debt relative to operating cash flow, indicating debt servicing capacity. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
A liquidity ratio that measures a company's ability to cover its short-term liabilities with only cash and cash equivalents. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
A distress metric derived from Credit Default Swap (CDS) data, used to signal credit risk. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
The 5-week average volatility of the gross notional value of outstanding CDS contracts for a reference entity. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
The 1-month growth rate in the gross notional value of outstanding CDS contracts for a reference entity. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
The 1-year growth rate in the gross notional value of outstanding CDS contracts for a reference entity. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
The gross notional value of outstanding Credit Default Swap (CDS) contracts referencing an entity's debt. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
The change in the 5-week volatility of the gross notional value of outstanding CDS contracts. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
The beta of an entity's CDS spread relative to a CDS index, indicating its sensitivity to systematic credit market movements. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
The change in the EBITDA to debt ratio over a specified period, signaling shifts in a company's leverage. This corresponds to the EBITDADebtChg field in the documentation.
A liquidity ratio measuring a company's ability to pay short-term obligations with its current assets. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
A crowding indicator representing the relative demand versus supply for an entity's debt. This corresponds to the Dmd_Supply field in the documentation.
A leverage ratio of a company's Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization (EBITDA) to its total debt. This corresponds to the EBITDADebt field in the documentation.
Observed PD minus fair value PD predicted by a proprietary model using Comprehensive Debt to Total Assets with sector, credit rating, and regional controls
Observed PD minus fair value PD predicted by a proprietary model using Comprehensive Debt to Total Assets (deep value specification)
Observed PD minus fair value PD predicted by a proprietary model using Interest Coverage (deep value specification)
Difference between observed probability of default and model fair value predicted using an Interest Coverage–based model with sector, credit rating, and regional controls
Most recently reported total debt divided by total assets
Comprehensive debt to total assets: sum of long-term debt, short-term debt, underfunded pensions, operating lease expense, and preferred stock divided by total assets
Most recent quarter retained earnings divided by most recent quarter total assets (retained earnings over assets)
Trailing 12-month income before extraordinary items divided by average total assets over the same period
Most recently reported quarterly total assets divided by book equity
Standard deviation of daily 5-year CDS spread changes over the trailing one month
Sensitivity of daily CDS spread changes to those of the average company in the Markit CDX North America IG index (higher sensitivity ranks higher)
Sensitivity of daily CDS spread changes to those of the Canada sovereign CDS (higher sensitivity ranks higher)
Ranked sensitivity of daily CDS spread changes to daily EUR/USD exchange-rate changes; higher rank indicates stronger sensitivity
Sensitivity of daily CDS spread changes to those of the France sovereign CDS (higher sensitivity ranks higher)
Ranked sensitivity (beta) of a name’s daily CDS spread changes to changes in Germany sovereign CDS spreads; higher rank indicates higher sensitivity
Ranked sensitivity (beta) of a name’s daily CDS spread changes to changes in Italy sovereign CDS spreads; higher rank indicates higher sensitivity
Ranked sensitivity (beta) of a name’s daily CDS spread changes to changes in Japan sovereign CDS spreads; higher rank indicates higher sensitivity
Sensitivity of daily CDS spread changes to daily oil price changes (higher sensitivity ranks higher)
Sensitivity of daily CDS spread changes to those of the Portugal sovereign CDS (higher sensitivity ranks higher)
Probability of default implied by the 1-year CDS spread
Probability of default implied by the 5-year CDS spread
Difference between the 1-month Active Return equity factor rank and the 1-month Change in PD (5Y) rank
Difference between the 5-day Industry Relative Return equity factor rank and the 5-day Change in Probability of Default (5Y) rank
Proprietary model residual linking equity price to CDS spread, adjusted by the strength of the cross-asset relationship
Ranked sensitivity (beta) of a name’s daily CDS spread changes to changes in Spain sovereign CDS spreads; higher rank indicates higher sensitivity
Ranked sensitivity (beta) of a name’s daily CDS spread changes to changes in United Kingdom sovereign CDS spreads; higher rank indicates higher sensitivity
Ranked sensitivity (beta) of a name’s daily CDS spread changes to changes in United States sovereign CDS spreads; higher rank indicates higher sensitivity
12-month relative change in total debt, where total debt = long-term debt + short-term debt
Trailing 12-month operating cash flow minus the comparable value from 12 quarters ago, scaled by average total assets over the same period
Percent change in shares outstanding compared to one year ago
Quarterly cash flow from operations minus cash dividends, divided by current interest-bearing debt
Five-year growth in dividends
Standard deviation of the stock’s daily total returns over the trailing one month
Observed PD minus fair value PD predicted by a proprietary model using the 1-month realized stock return volatility factor with sector, credit rating, and regional controls
Difference between reported accounting earnings and free cash flow, scaled by average assets
Trailing 12-month EBITDA divided by enterprise value (EV = equity market value + long-term debt + short-term debt + preferred stock + minority interest − cash)
Total long-term debt divided by total book equity
TTM cash flow minus comparable TTM cash flow from 4 quarters ago, scaled by average total assets
Most recent quarterly earnings surprise scaled by the standard deviation of analyst forecasts
Weighted average of FY1 analyst upward minus downward revisions in a month divided by total revisions
Long-term debt divided by total assets minus current liabilities
Consensus long-term growth forecast, representing expected annual growth in operating earnings over the next business cycle
Lagged quarterly ROE relative to industry average standardized by industry standard deviation
Four-week stock return relative to industry average standardized by industry standard deviation
Five-day stock return relative to industry average standardized by industry standard deviation
3-month change in the median FY1 consensus earnings forecast, scaled by the current mean earnings estimate
Net debt divided by net debt plus preferred stock plus common stock; net debt = long-term debt + short-term debt - cash and equivalents (most recent quarter)
NOPAT margin = (Net income + Interest expense*(1 - effective tax rate)) / Net sales, using trailing 12 months; effective tax rate = TTM income taxes / TTM income before taxes
1 minus [(short-term debt + long-term debt + common equity + preferred equity - cash) / (total assets - cash)] in the current quarter
Difference between the year-over-year percent change in operating income and the year-over-year percent change in long-term debt
Percent change in trailing 12-month operating income from the prior quarter divided by the percent change in trailing 12-month sales from the prior quarter
Ranked sensitivity of daily CDS spread changes to daily returns of the Markit iTraxx Crossover index; higher rank indicates stronger sensitivity
Unexpected profitability: realized profitability minus the expected level estimated by a regression model
Six-month average of the monthly change in the average analyst recommendation
Retention (reinvestment) rate: (TTM EPS before extraordinary items - TTM dividends per share by ex-date) divided by average book equity per share over the same period
Change in the mean analyst earnings estimate for fiscal year 2 from three months ago to now, scaled by the forecast standard deviation as of three months ago
(Trailing 12-month net income + interest expense) divided by average invested capital (common equity + long-term debt + minority interest + preferred stock)
Latest reported quarterly operating income divided by total assets lagged by 12 months
Standard deviation of analyst EPS estimates for fiscal year 1 divided by the mean consensus forecast
Consensus analyst recommendation for the company
(Cash flow from operations + interest paid + tax paid) divided by (interest + principal paid)
Ranked sensitivity of the daily CDS spread to daily equity price changes; higher rank indicates stronger sensitivity
Most recent daily trading volume divided by the average daily trading volume over the previous 50 trading days
Most recent quarterly operating income before depreciation divided by quarterly long-term debt interest expense
Sensitivity of daily CDS spread changes to daily changes in market volatility (VIX) (higher sensitivity ranks higher)
One-day change in the CDS-implied 1-year probability of default (from t-1 to t)
Change in the 1-year CDS-implied probability of default from date t-5 to date t
Change in the 1-year CDS-implied probability of default from month t-1 to month t
Change in the 5-year CDS-implied probability of default from date t-1 to date t
Change in the CDS-implied 5-year probability of default from date t-5 to date t
Change in the 5-year CDS-implied probability of default from month t-1 to month t
Year-over-year change in total liabilities as a percentage of total assets (most recent quarter vs. same quarter a year ago)
A company's net cash flow divided by the number of its outstanding shares, indicating financial strength per share. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
A probabilistic model score that assesses the likelihood of a company going bankrupt within two years. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
A ratio measuring how well current liabilities are covered by the cash flow generated from a company's operations. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
A general distress metric (DM), likely derived from fundamental or market-based signals. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
A liquidity ratio (acid-test) measuring a company's ability to meet short-term obligations with its most liquid assets. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
A crowding indicator representing the ratio of shorted shares to average daily trading volume, also known as Days to Cover. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
A crowding indicator representing the ratio of shares sold short, used for monitoring short interest levels. This corresponds to the Sht_Int field in the documentation.
The cost to borrow a stock for short-selling purposes, serving as a crowding indicator. Corresponds to the `Benchmark_fee` field.
The year-over-year change in a company's current ratio, reflecting trends in its short-term liquidity. Data is provided as an integer rank or standardized score.
